title: AI Engineer / AI Developer
description: We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.Job BriefWe are seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer / AI Developer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions that solve complex business challenges. title: Applied AI Engineer
description: WELL Health Technologies is an innovative technology-enabled healthcare company whose overarching objective is to positively impact health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower and support healthcare practitioners and their patients.WELL has built an innovative practitioner enablement platform that includes comprehensive end to end practice management tools inclusive of virtual care and digital patient engagement capabilities as well as Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and data protection services. WELL Health Technologies, uses this platform to power healthcare practitioners both inside and outside of WELL Health Technologies' own omni-channel patient services offerings.WELL owns and operates Canada's largest network of outpatient medical clinics serving primary and specialized healthcare services and is the provider of a leading multi-national multi-disciplinary telehealth offering. WELL Health Technologies is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol "WELL".To learn more about the company, please visit: www.well.company.The opportunityReporting to the Senior Director, Digital Transformation, the Applied AI Engineer will design, build, deploy, and optimize AI-powered solutions that create measurable business value.This is a hands-on engineering role focused on applying AI to real business challenges, not building foundation models. Working closely with business, data, and technology teams, you will take AI solutions from concept to production, delivering agents, assistants, automations, and applications that help teams work smarter.Joining WELL's growing Business Transformation team, you will help shape the future of AI across one of Canada's leading healthcare technology organizations.This is a fully remote role based anywhere in Canada, with a preference for candidates located in Toronto or Vancouver.Who you areYou are an experienced software engineer and builder with strong applied AI capabilities, energized by turning ideas into solutions people actually use. You take ownership of the full journey — from design and development through deployment and continuous improvement.You combine technical skill with curiosity and business acumen, asking thoughtful questions and working closely with stakeholders before determining the best path forward. You thrive where ambiguity exists, building practical solutions that improve efficiency, support decision-making, and automate workflows.You understand that successful AI solutions require more than great prompts — they require thoughtful integration, secure data access, testing, monitoring, governance, and ongoing iteration to be reliable, scalable, and trusted.What's in it for youBuild what's next. Join a growing team building enterprise AI capabilities from the ground up, contributing to high-impact initiatives and influencing how WELL leverages AI in the years ahead.Make an impact. See your work move into production, gain adoption, and deliver measurable outcomes — not just experimentation.Grow with the team. Work alongside experienced AI, data, and technology leaders with increasing opportunities as WELL expands its AI capabilities.You will:Build AI solutions. You will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered solutions that help teams work smarter and make better decisions. Working closely with business stakeholders, data teams, and technology partners, you will translate business needs into practical applications, intelligent agents, assistants, workflow automations, and other AI-enabled solutions.Connect data and systems. You will connect AI capabilities with enterprise data, systems, APIs, and business applications, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise standards. You will partner with Data Engineering and Technology teams to establish reliable data access patterns and support long-term maintainability.Optimize performance. As solutions move into production, you will be responsible for evaluating performance, monitoring effectiveness, implementing appropriate controls and guardrails, and continuously improving outcomes based on user feedback and business results.Evaluate and Improve AI Performance. You will design testing and evaluation approaches to measure solution quality, accuracy, reliability, and business effectiveness. You will monitor production AI solutions and continuously improve performance based on user feedback and operational metrics. An important part of this role is the ability to implement guardrails, access controls, and monitoring to support responsible AI use.Drive adoption. Along the way, you will collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to identify opportunities, demonstrate solutions, educate users, and help drive the successful adoption of AI technologies.Here's what you bring:Technical foundation. You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, solution engineering, data engineering, or related technical roles. You have experience designing, building, and deploying production AI solutions and understand the realities of supporting those solutions after launch. You have strong programming skills in Python and experience with APIs, databases, cloud environments, and enterprise integrations to connect systems, data, and AI capabilities to solve business challenges.AI expertise. You have hands-on experience building and deploying solutions using modern large language model platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar technologies. You have applied concepts such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, workflow orchestration, and agent-based architectures in working applications.Delivery mindset. You bring a strong delivery mindset. You enjoy taking ownership, working through ambiguity, and moving solutions from concept to production. You understand how to balance innovation with practicality and are motivated by building solutions that create meaningful business outcomes. You are equally comfortable making sound technical decisions and getting hands on to implement them.Stakeholder partnership. You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, collaborating to understand business challenges, align priorities, and translate needs into practical solutions.Curiosity and continuous learning. You are naturally curious, eager to learn, and energized by solving complex problems. You think beyond immediate requirements and are always looking for better ways to create value through technology.Preferred qualificationsWhile not required, experience building AI assistants, agents, workflow automations, enterprise search, or knowledge management solutions would be an asset. Additional experience with LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and AI orchestration and automation tooling such as LangGraph, n8n, or Logic Apps, as well as AI monitoring, evaluation, and observability practices, would help you ramp up quickly. Experience working in healthcare, regulated industries, or privacy-sensitive environments is also considered an asset.Apply nowInterested in applying but worried you don't have it all? At WELL, we know not everyone gains their experience following a traditional path. If you share our values, want to make a difference in healthcare technology solutions, and meet 70% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Express your interest here.What you can expect from our interview process:A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor discussing your interest in the role and your experience.A 45-minute virtual technical interview with a Senior AI Engineer to discuss your technical experience, AI solution delivery, and approach to building enterprise-ready applications.A final virtual interview with the Senior Director, Digital Transformation and VP, Business Transformation to discuss business impact, collaboration, and alignment with WELL's vision for AI.CompensationThe salary range for this position is $150K–$170K. The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At WELL, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.WELL is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome and celebrate the diversity of applicants and team members across ability, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, and lived experience. We strive to create an environment where differences are valued and contribute to our collective success – this is the WELL Way.WELL has been independently certified as a Great Place to Work® by the Great Place to Work Institute® Canada. This recognition reflects our commitment to building a workplace culture rooted in trust, inclusivity, and employee well-being. It also aligns with our Healthy Place to Work pillar and the priorities outlined in our annual Sustainability Impact Report.Read more about us: https://stories.well.company/ Show more Show less

title: Senior Agentic AI Developer
description: About UsCoderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. With a strong technical foundation and a product-oriented mindset, our teams lead complex software projects from architecture to execution. We value autonomy, clear communication, and technical excellence. We work closely with international teams and partners, creating technology that makes a difference.More information: http://coderio.comThe RoleWe are seeking a Senior Enterprise AI & Automation Engineer to design, build, and operate intelligent workflows and conversational agents at scale. This role bridges the gap between advanced AI development (Python, LLMs) and enterprise operations (Microsoft Stack, Azure).You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of mission-critical AI solutions: developing custom agents, integrating them with enterprise data platforms (Snowflake), and ensuring robust observability (Splunk) in cloud environments. If you thrive in complex ecosystems and know how to turn AI capabilities into tangible business value—while leveraging tools like Cursor IDE or GitHub Copilot to accelerate your own delivery—this high-impact role is for you.What To Expect In This Role (Responsibilities)AI & Agentic Development: Design and build conversational solutions, custom copilots, and agentic workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, and custom Python architectures. Enterprise Integration: Connect AI agents and automated workflows seamlessly with enterprise data ecosystems, specifically Snowflake and SharePoint. Cloud & Infrastructure: Architect and operate resilient, large-scale cloud infrastructures on Azure, managing deployments via CI/CD pipelines (YAML, GitOps patterns). Observability & Governance: Develop advanced monitoring, logging, and auditing strategies using Splunk to track agent performance, latency, and operational bottlenecks. Engineering Excellence: Actively leverage AI-assisted development tools (Cursor IDE, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate coding, improve code quality, and set best practices for the team. Technical Leadership: Collaborate with cross-functional, global teams, providing technical direction, participating in client discussions, and recommending emerging AI technologies. Requirements5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Automation roles with demonstrated impact at an enterprise scale. 4+ years of hands-on experience developing with Python (building robust backend services, APIs, and data integrations). 2+ years of experience designing and deploying solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio (or Power Virtual Agents) and Power Automate. Proven experience building agentic workflows or AI pipelines, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into business processes. Solid cloud expertise, strongly focused on Azure (AWS is a plus). Experience integrating applications or agents with Snowflake. Proven background in building high-volume logging and monitoring ecosystems (e.g., Splunk, multi-region ingestion, automated reporting). Daily active user of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE, ChatGPT) to optimize engineering workflows. Bilingual English Nice to HaveHands-on experience with Azure DevOps (pipelines, repos, artifacts, YAML). Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen). Experience with SharePoint integrations, reusable modules, and reproducible infrastructure standards. Benefits100% remote work. High-impact strategic role with autonomy and ownership. Opportunity to scale cloud and automation practices in global environments. Collaborative senior engineering culture with strong technical leadership. Clear growth pathway and access to leadership opportunities. Why Join Coderio?At Coderio, we value talent regardless of location. We are a fully remote company passionate about technology, collaboration, and fair compensation. We offer an inclusive and challenging environment with real growth opportunities. If you are motivated to design scalable cloud infrastructures, elevate DevOps practices, and build AI-powered automation that makes a difference, we’d love to meet you.Apply now.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Show more Show less
